Official default settings model, explicit confirmation, optimistic conflict, read-only/unavailable, one-shot apply to existing Sessions and durable recovery
assertions: saving the default changes only future Sessions; existing Session permissions stay byte-for-byte unchanged
apply to existing Sessions is a separate owner action with target count, workspace scope, exclusions and unsupported reasons
cancel, stale revision and full-access refusal perform no permission write
applied effective permissions are read back; partial failure and read-back mismatch are visible and never retried

explicit owner recovery
staged review and human completion gates
structured criteria and image evidence

a successor is not claimed while its dependency is not done
accepting the dependency admits the successor without auto-accepting it
analysis remains serial while execution lanes continue
tasks sharing a resource key never run concurrently
card and detail show the current in-progress holder
the key is released when the holder leaves in-progress
the persisted lane count bounds concurrent execution

another running lane still reports evidence
